in_sanskrit.name: Makwana
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Forest
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Makwana एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Makwana is a Marathi name derived from the word 'Makkandeshwar', which means 'Lord of the Forest'. This name is believed to bring strength and protection, and is often given to boys in Hindu communities.
